source_description: One-time, human-reviewed rules mapping exams.json records to research batches. Applied in order, first match wins. Regenerate with scripts/data-sourcing/build-batch-map.mjs whenever exams.json gains new records — the generator never reassigns an id that batches.json already has a batch_id for.
